actions.description: Attach a label to a Linear issue.
actions.name: add-issue-label

id.description: The identifier of the issue to add the label to. Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

labelId.description: The identifier of the label to add. Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001"

actions.description: Archive a Linear cycle.
actions.name: archive-cycle

id.description: The identifier of the cycle to archive. Example: "cycle-uuid"

actions.description: Archive a Linear issue so it is removed from active workflows.
actions.name: archive-issue

id.description: The identifier of the issue to archive. Example: "c0b0b0b0-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" or "TEAM-123"

actions.description: Create an attachment on a Linear issue.
actions.name: create-attachment

issueId.description: The issue to associate the attachment with. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., LIN-123). Example: "590a1127-f98b-49fc-ba74-2df8751c089e"

url.description: Attachment location which is also used as a unique identifier for the attachment. Example: "https://example.com/123"

iconUrl.description: An icon url to display with the attachment. Should be of jpg or png format. Example: "https://example.com/icon.png"

metadata.description: Attachment metadata object with string and number values. Example: {"exceptionId": "exc-123"}

groupBySource.description: Indicates if attachments for the same source application should be grouped in the Linear UI.

createAsUser.description: Create attachment as a user with the provided name. This option is only available to OAuth applications creating attachments in actor=application mode.

commentBody.description: Create a linked comment with markdown body.

actions.description: Create a comment on a Linear issue.
actions.name: create-comment

issueId.description: The ID of the Linear issue to comment on. Example: "issue-uuid"

parentId.description: The ID of the parent comment for threaded replies.

actions.description: Create a cycle for a Linear team.
actions.name: create-cycle

teamId.description: The ID of the team this cycle belongs to. Example: "9cfb482a-81e3-4154-b5b9-2c805e70a02d"

name.description: The name of the cycle. Example: "Sprint 23"

startsAt.description: The start date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"

endsAt.description: The end date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-29T00:00:00Z"

completedAt.description: The completion date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format.

actions.description: Create a Linear issue label.
actions.name: create-issue-label

name.description: The name of the issue label. Example: "Bug"

color.description: The color of the label as a HEX string. Example: "#EB5757"

teamId.description: The identifier of the team to associate the label with. If omitted, the label will be workspace-level.

actions.description: Create a relationship between two Linear issues.
actions.name: create-issue-relation

issueId.description: ID of the primary issue. Example: "c5748ccf-c67f-4af4-bd74-fe513dc4c054"

relatedIssueId.description: ID of the related issue. Example: "71bc4480-3aa1-4c56-b657-827996658662"

type.description: Type of relationship between the issues.

actions.description: Create a new Linear issue.
actions.name: create-issue

actions.description: Create a Linear project.
actions.name: create-project

leadId.description: The identifier of the project lead.

teamIds.description: The identifiers of the teams this project is associated with.

targetDate.description: The planned target date of the project in ISO date format.

startDate.description: The planned start date of the project in ISO date format.

status.description: The state of the project (e.g. planned, started, paused, completed, canceled).

actions.description: Delete an attachment from a Linear issue.
actions.name: delete-attachment

attachmentId.description: The identifier of the attachment to delete. Example: "f4485af5-5d5a-4baf-bb8f-d66cbf7254c8"

actions.description: Delete a comment from a Linear issue.
actions.name: delete-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "abc123"

actions.description: Delete a Linear issue label.
actions.name: delete-issue-label

labelId.description: The ID of the issue label to delete. Example: "label-uuid"

actions.description: Delete a relationship between two Linear issues.
actions.name: delete-issue-relation

id.description: The identifier of the issue relation to delete. Example: "abc123-def456"

actions.description: Delete a Linear issue.
actions.name: delete-issue

id.description: The identifier of the issue to delete. Example: "3e03fa02-a23a-40ac-93f4-bbdfd6120caf"

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear attachment by attachment ID.
actions.name: get-attachment

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear comment by comment ID.
actions.name: get-comment

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear cycle by cycle ID.
actions.name: get-cycle

id.description: The unique identifier of the Linear cycle. Example: "cycle-id-123"

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear issue label by label ID.
actions.name: get-issue-label

id.description: The unique identifier of the issue label. Example: "abc123-def456"

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear issue by issue ID.
actions.name: get-issue

id.description: Issue ID or identifier. Example: "c7a3b3c0-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" or "TEAM-123"

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear project by project ID.
actions.name: get-project

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the Linear project. Example: "7b277fbc-8b76-4cdc-ad25-cd735ca33d0c"

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear team by team ID.
actions.name: get-team

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear user by user ID.
actions.name: get-user

actions.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated Linear user.
actions.name: get-viewer

actions.description: Retrieve a Linear workflow state by state ID.
actions.name: get-workflow-state

stateId.description: The ID of the workflow state to retrieve. Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

actions.description: List Linear attachments with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-attachments

first.description: The number of items to forward paginate. Defaults to 50.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

filter.description: Filter returned attachments using Linear AttachmentFilter fields.

orderBy.description: By which field should the pagination order. Available options are createdAt (default) and updatedAt.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results, if available.

actions.description: List Linear comments with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-comments

first.description: Number of items to return. Defaults to 50.

actions.description: List Linear cycles with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-cycles

first.description: Number of cycles to return. Example: 10

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

filter.description: Cycle filter object. Example: { team: { id: { eq: "team-id" } } }

actions.description: List Linear issue labels with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-issue-labels

first.description: The number of items to forward paginate. Defaults to 50.

after.description: A cursor to be used with first for forward pagination.

actions.description: List Linear issues with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-issues

first.description: Number of issues to return per page. Example: 50

after.description: Pagination cursor for forward pagination. Example: "eyJvcmRlciI6..."

orderBy.description: Field to order by. Example: "updatedAt" or "createdAt"

filter.description: Issue filter object. Example: { state: { type: { eq: "started" } } }

nextCursor.description: Convenience field matching pageInfo.endCursor when hasNextPage is true

actions.description: List Linear projects with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-projects

first.description: Number of projects to return. Maximum: 100.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

filter.description: Project filter object. Example: { state: { eq: "started" } }

actions.description: List Linear teams available to the authenticated user.
actions.name: list-teams

first.description: Number of teams to return per page. Default: 50.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List Linear users with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-users

first.description: The number of items to return per page. Max 250. Example: 50

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Example: "abc123"

orderBy.description: Order by field. Available options are createdAt (default) and updatedAt. Example: "updatedAt"

active.description: Filter by user active state. Example: true

includeDisabled.description: Include disabled/suspended users (default: false). Example: true

actions.description: List Linear workflow states across teams.
actions.name: list-workflow-states

first.description: Number of workflow states to return. Defaults to 50.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Remove a label from a Linear issue.
actions.name: remove-issue-label

issueId.description: The identifier of the issue to remove the label from. Example: "ISS-123"

labelId.description: The identifier of the label to remove. Example: "label-uuid"

actions.description: Resolve a Linear comment thread.
actions.name: resolve-comment

id.description: The identifier of the comment to resolve. Example: "comment-id-123"

resolvingCommentId.description: The identifier of the child comment that resolves the thread. If not provided, the thread is resolved without a specific resolving comment.

actions.description: Search Linear issues with full-text query support.
actions.name: search-issues

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Default: 50.

actions.description: Restore an archived Linear issue.
actions.name: unarchive-issue

actions.description: Restore an archived Linear project.
actions.name: unarchive-project

projectId.description: The identifier of the project to restore. Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

actions.description: Reopen a previously resolved Linear comment thread.
actions.name: unresolve-comment

id.description: The identifier of the comment to unresolve. Example: "comment-id-123"

lastSyncId.description: The identifier of the last sync operation.

commentId.description: The identifier of the unresolved comment.

actions.description: Update a comment on a Linear issue.
actions.name: update-comment

id.description: The ID of the comment to update. Example: "comment-id-123"

body.description: The new text content for the comment.

actions.description: Update an existing Linear cycle.
actions.name: update-cycle

id.description: The identifier of the cycle to update. Example: "cycle-id"

name.description: The custom name of the cycle.

startsAt.description: The start date and time of the cycle. ISO 8601 format.

endsAt.description: The end date and time of the cycle. ISO 8601 format.

completedAt.description: The completion time of the cycle. Pass null to mark as uncompleted.

actions.description: Update an existing Linear issue label.
actions.name: update-issue-label

id.description: The identifier of the label to update.

color.description: The color of the label as a HEX string.

actions.description: Update fields on an existing Linear issue relation.
actions.name: update-issue-relation

id.description: The identifier of the issue relation to update. Example: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"

issueId.description: The identifier of the issue that is related to another issue. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

relatedIssueId.description: The identifier of the related issue. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

type.description: The type of relation of the issue to the related issue.

actions.description: Update fields on an existing Linear issue
actions.name: update-issue

id.description: The identifier of the issue to update. Example: "ISSUE-123" or UUID

description.description: The description of the issue in markdown format. Pass null to clear.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = no priority, 1 = urgent, 2 = high, 3 = medium, 4 = low. Pass null to clear.

stateId.description: The identifier of the workflow state to move the issue to. Pass null to clear.

assigneeId.description: The identifier of the user to assign the issue to. Pass null to clear.

labelIds.description: The identifiers of labels to attach to the issue. Pass null to clear.

projectId.description: The identifier of the project to add the issue to. Pass null to clear.

actions.description: Update an existing Linear project.
actions.name: update-project

projectId.description: The identifier of the project to update. Example: "project-uuid"

name.description: The new name of the project.

description.description: The new description of the project.

status.description: The ID of the project status to set.

targetDate.description: The planned target date of the project in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2025-12-31"

leadId.description: The identifier of the project lead. Example: "user-uuid"
